scope: Exact known Ghost standalone DLLs only; configuration, profile records, other mods and unknown builds are preserved.
recovery: Per-file verified copies and migration.json are written to profile/GhostBackups/legacy-plugins-* before removing any duplicate DLL from BepInEx/plugins.
gameplay_validation: Requires user game session; automated verification does not claim live gameplay testing.
regression: Production IPC readFile returns UTF-8 text. The actual production adapter regression fails on 1.0.13; base64 transport preserves binary bytes and allows exact hash matching in 1.0.14.
regression_before_fix: Production-adapter test failed: expected one migrated file, got zero.
regression_after_fix: Same production-adapter test passed and verified byte-identical backup.
